text:
elaine: Heads-up — after today's outage we saw recurring p95 spikes tied to KV eviction + cache cold-starts. Postmortem notes here: https://redwood/pm/eviction-2026. Proposals: 1) nightly regression to simulate prefix/KV miss load, 2) add promptset covering long-convo context, 3) quarterly chaos drill for eviction. Looking for owners.

jas: +1. I can own the nightly regression. Will wire into CI and a small smoke job.

jas: Plan: add a pytest that spins up a model stub + KV stub, will land by Fri. Command to run locally:
```
PYTEST_ADDOPTS="-k kv_cold" pytest tests/regress/kv_cold_test.py::test_prefix_miss -q
```

sam: I can take promptsets and evals. Will assemble initial 25 prompts from incident logs by Tue and push to redwood/evals/promptsets/kv-eviction.

li: Ops: let's schedule a chaos drill. Proposed slot: next Wed 11:00 PT. @ops-bot can you create invite and runbook link?

ops-bot: Created calendar event: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-chaos-177777 and runbook stub at https://docs.redwood/eviction-chaos-runbook.

maria: Also adding a nightly load test for Dedicated: ramp to 200rps for 10m with KV eviction toggle. Need capacity approval from infra; will open RFC.

sam: Note — capture baseline metrics (p50/p95, token-cost) before landing tests. I'll add a small eval that records those snapshots.

elaine: Owners recap: jas -> nightly regression (WIP, due Fri), sam -> promptset + evals (due Tue), maria -> load test + capacity RFC (EOW), li -> chaos drill scheduling & runbook (next Wed). I'll update the postmortem tracker.

elaine: Tracker: https://tracker.redwood/RED-1123. Please paste PR links and CI jobs into the ticket and mark them as remediation+test.

qa-bot: Reminder: new tests should include labels `regression/kv-eviction` and `smoke` and add a short flakiness note in the PR template.

sam: Acked, will include labels and flakiness notes. :thumbsup:
